desc: `first_occurrence[val]` and `last_occurrence[val]`: To quickly locate the boundaries of any value $x$.
Initialize `ans` with the maximum subarray sum of the original array (computed via standard Kadane's).
Iterate through each unique value $x$ present in `nums`:
Determine the range of indices to remove: from `first_occurrence[x]` to `last_occurrence[x]`.
Calculate the maximum subarray sum if $x$ is removed by considering:
The best subarray entirely in the left part (`prefix_max` up to `first_occurrence[x] - 1`).
The best subarray entirely in the right part (`suffix_max` from `last_occurrence[x] + 1`).
